# The Exchange endpoint property changes while the stored ews_url key stays the same

The shared EWS/Graph configuration uses incoming.exchangeURL for its in-memory endpoint. Backend account creation still writes that value with setStringValue("ews_url", ...). The form, DOM and label names broaden to Exchange without renaming that stored server key. This is a scoped mapping; it does not prove backward compatibility for every external XML field or outgoing API.

Scope: account-hub/exchange-endpoint-names.
